Jia: quick dump from a lightweight speculative-decoding bring-up on titan-12b-q4. ran greedy vs spec (prefill=6, width=4). baseline median=380ms, spec median=210ms (~1.8x). p95: 740ms -> 410ms. quality on eval-smoketest-500: EM -0.5% absolute, BLEU ~no-change. small regressions concentrated on short math tokens and decimals. logs below + a couple flagged samples.
Marco: nice numbers. what exact eval set and sampling params?
Jia: eval set = eval-smoketest-500 (mix: code snippets, arithmetic, 4 longform). temp=0.2 seed=42 topk=50. spec config: lookahead=3 accept_threshold=0.7. run command used: 
```
python run_spec.py --model titan-12b-q4 --prefill 6 --width 4 --accept 0.7 --eval eval-smoketest-500 --seed 42
```
Marco: did you hold cached-KV baseline and batching equal? concurrency?
Jia: yes cached-KV baseline included. batch_size=8, concurrency=16 for both. also tested no-cache: numbers degrade ~15% but relative spec speedup persists. caching removed ~20% total tokens in this workload.
Tess: curious if quantization is amplifying acceptance mistakes (rounding causes alt tokens to appear). any sign of logits collapse?
Jia: saw a small top-mass shift for numeric tokens (0-9) — more spread after q4 rounding. alphabetic tokens stable. one failure case: spec accepted an early token that later diverged and produced wrong numeric output (sample attached). suspect layernorm quant rounding at some early layer.
Ketan: can you paste an example diff? quick snippet is fine.
Jia: sample (gold vs spec accepted):
```
gold: "Result: 3.14159"
spec: "Result: 3.1416"  <-- acceptable for some apps, bad for exact-match tests
```
ci-bot: Run 7254322005 completed: spec-vs-greedy-500 samples. metrics: EM_delta=-0.005, BLEU_delta=+0.0002, p50_latency_delta=-170ms, p95_latency_delta=-330ms. 3 failing samples flagged to /tmp/artifacts/7254322005_failures.json
Marco: we need systematic ablations: lookahead 1/3/6, accept 0.6/0.7/0.8, temps 0.0/0.2/0.6. also run deterministic seeds and a holdout of >=2k samples.
Tess: agreed. I'll queue the ablations and add explicit per-prefix accept_rate and KV-hit logging. I'll also export diffs to a private gist for triage.
Jia: plan: run 2k holdout across task slices (math, code, longform). include q8+q4 baselines, and run at temp 0.0 + 0.2. gating rule: if EM regression >1% absolute on any slice -> block rollout. tagging @eng-platform for rollout gating and @eng-ops for perf expectations.
Marco: also record accept_rate distribution by token position and success conditional on first-accept correctness. that should show if early accept mistakes are concentrated near prefix boundaries.
Ketan: for quant debugging, add float32 debug run on the failing samples to confirm it's a quant-only artifact. if float32 matches gold, we pin to q4 error.
Jia: yes will run float32 check. next action: ablations queued, float32 diffs run, and I'll post a summary + top 10 failure examples in ~4 hours :clock4:.
Tess: thanks — will follow up once ablations finish. :thumbsup:
